items.action: Amendment SA 5441 agreed to in Senate by Unanimous Consent.
items.label: S.Amdt. 5441
items.purpose: To require a report on Department of Justice activity relating to certain programs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals and entities investigated or prosecuted for fraud under the Shuttered Venue Operators Grant and Restaurant Revitalization programs.
dimensions.evidence: any criminal prosecution or civil enforcement action for a violation... with respect to any grant for shuttered venue operators... shall be filed not later than 10 years

dimensions.assessment: Exposes potential fraud offenders to legal enforcement actions and prosecutions for a longer duration than previously allowed.
dimensions.evidence: shall be filed not later than 10 years after the date of the violation or conspiracy.

dimensions.assessment: May result in fund recoveries through enforcement actions, though no specific fiscal targets or administrative spending amounts are detailed.
dimensions.evidence: the total dollar amount recovered by prosecutions

dimensions.assessment: Amends enforcement terms for specific SBA pandemic relief programs and institutes regular reporting requirements for the Department of Justice.
dimensions.evidence: the Attorney General shall submit to Congress a report on activities of the Department of Justice

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a 10-year statute of limitations for specific violations and mandates DOJ reporting every 90 days for 5 years.
dimensions.evidence: every 90 days thereafter until the date that is 5 years after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: Total number of active investigations or potential cases subject to the extended timeline
Estimated total dollar value of funds potentially subject to fraud recovery
importance_detail.rationale: Extends the statute of limitations for criminal prosecutions and civil enforcement actions related to fraud in specific pandemic relief programs to 10 years.
